title: unidrive config.toml
description: Mirrors RawGeneral and RawProvider in core/app/sync/.../SyncConfig.kt. A test keeps the property names in lockstep.

exclude_patterns.description: Paths never synced, in either direction, for every profile. unidrive's own glob syntax (config.example.toml spells it out): * and ? stay within one name, **/ at the start and /** at the end span folders, a pattern without '/' (a leading '/' does not count) is matched against the name at any depth, and matching is case-sensitive. There is no {a,b} alternation and no [...] class: '[', ']', '{' and '}' match themselves, and such a pattern logs a warning.

mode.description: #603 (U4): the profile's hosting mode, chosen at creation and fixed. A profile without one is refused.

label.description: Free display text for front-ends, stored as typed. Display only: the profile name stays the identity, and changing the label renames nothing.

allow_drive_root.description: localfs only: accept a drive or filesystem root (X:\, /) as root_path, which is refused otherwise. `profile add --option allow_drive_root=true` writes it as a string; true and "true" read the same.

exclude_patterns.description: Added to [general] exclude_patterns for this profile; the same syntax.

sync_path.description: Remote subtree(s) this profile syncs. Absolute remote paths starting with '/'. Absent means the whole drive. The CLI --sync-path overrides it for one invocation; `unidrive scope set|clear` changes it and applies the scope transition.

hydration_cache_max_bytes.description: Budget of this profile's hydration cache in bytes (the copies reads and writes through the mount leave under ~/.cache/unidrive/hydration/<profile>). Least recently used copies that hold nothing the cloud or the sync root does not are evicted after each close, after each upload and at daemon start. 0 means unlimited. Default 21474836480 (20 GiB).

honor_gitignore.description: Also read `.gitignore` files as ignore rules for uploads, beside `.unidrive.ignore`. Default false.

ignore_rules.description: The account's own ignore rules for uploads, in git's syntax, applied at the root: below every `.unidrive.ignore` (and `.gitignore` with honor_gitignore), above the built-in defaults. An ignored file is never uploaded; cloud items stay visible. Separate from exclude_patterns, which keep their glob syntax.

trash_folder_name.description: The name of the read-only folder at the top of the profile that shows what the provider keeps in its trash (Internxt: the items below a trashed folder), under the path they came from. One folder name, no path; at most 100 characters. A client sets it from the user's language. Default "Papierkorb". A live top-level item with the same name keeps it, and the folder is shown as "<name> (2)".

shared_folder_name.description: The name of the read-only folder at the top of the profile that lists the items the account shares with others, a flat list in which each item is the real one under its own name and a folder is a read-only alias of the real folder (Internxt: files and folders with a share by a person or a link; what others share with it is not listed). Shown only with shared_view. One folder name, no path; at most 100 characters. A client sets it from the user's language. Default "Shared". A live top-level item with the same name keeps it, and the folder is shown as "<name> (2)".

shared_view.description: Whether a mount profile shows the read-only folder named by shared_folder_name, which lists the files and folders the account shares. A mirror profile never shows it. Only a provider that declares the view (Internxt) shows it; for any other there is no folder, whatever this says. Takes effect when the daemon starts. Default true.

recents_folder_name.description: The name of the read-only folder at the top of the profile that lists the files the account changed most recently, newest first, a flat list in which each file is the real one under its own name (Internxt). Shown only with recents_view. One folder name, no path; at most 100 characters. A client sets it from the user's language. Default "Recents". A live top-level item with the same name keeps it, and the folder is shown as "<name> (2)".

recents_view.description: Whether a mount profile shows the read-only folder named by recents_folder_name. A mirror profile never shows it. Only a provider that declares the view (Internxt) shows it; for any other there is no folder, whatever this says. Takes effect when the daemon starts. Default true.

recents_limit.description: How many files the Recents folder lists at most. Takes effect when the daemon starts. Default 50, the most the server answers with is 1000. A client's own list asks for the files after them page by page, up to 1000.

favorites_folder_name.description: The name of the read-only folder at the top of the profile that lists the files the account marked as favorites, a flat list in which each file is the real one under its own name (Internxt; favorited folders are not listed yet). Shown only with favorites_view. One folder name, no path; at most 100 characters. A client sets it from the user's language. Default "Favorites". A live top-level item with the same name keeps it, and the folder is shown as "<name> (2)".

favorites_view.description: Whether a mount profile shows the read-only folder named by favorites_folder_name. A mirror profile never shows it. Only a provider that declares the view (Internxt) shows it; for any other there is no folder, whatever this says. Takes effect when the daemon starts. Default true.

daemon_poll_seconds.description: How often `unidrive daemon run` polls the cloud for changes made elsewhere (web UI, another device, another profile on the same account), in seconds. The first poll runs at daemon start; after a provider failure the interval backs off (up to 10 min). Each poll is an incremental delta from the stored cursor. 0 turns polling off. Default 60. `daemon run --poll-interval` overrides it.

remote_notifications.description: OneDrive: open Graph's change-notification socket (socket.io, outbound, no server of ours) so that a change made elsewhere wakes the poll at once instead of at the next `daemon_poll_seconds`. The endpoint expires every 30 minutes and is renewed by itself; the poll stays the safety net. Default true; false polls only. `daemon.status` reports the channel as `notifications`. Other providers ignore it.

allow_unverified_shard_hash.description: Internxt: read a download whose recorded shard hash this client cannot check, without the integrity check. Default false: such a download is refused.

sync_direction.description: This profile's sync direction; overrides [general] sync_direction for this profile only. `unidrive backup add` writes "upload".

file_versioning.description: Overrides [general] file_versioning for this profile only.

max_versions.description: Overrides [general] max_versions for this profile only.

trash_emulation.description: Overrides [general] trash_emulation for this profile only.

trash_retention_days.description: Overrides [general] trash_retention_days for this profile only.
